sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The objective is to engage a Facilities Management (FM) Service Provider for both hard and soft FM services across 52 Martin Place and satellite offices.

The new FM contract will be established for a period of three years, with two options to extend for an additional 12 months, up to a potential of five years.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Scope of the Services required is set out in the Tender Documents specifically Part A.1 Introduction and Description​ and Part D.1 Draft Agreement.

The Tender Documents will be made available to Suppliers upon the completion of Part A.0 Mandatory Qualification Questions and acceptance from Premier's Department.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Please complete Part A.0 Mandatory Qualification Questions and submit your completed Qualifying Questions to 2026facilitiesmanagertender@premiersdepartment.nsw.gov.au before the 24th of September 2026.

Any Qualifying Question submission received after the 24th of September may not be reviewed by the Evaluation Committee and may not be considered for Qualification to the Tender.

Upon receipt of the completed Qualifying Questions, the Premier's Department will review the information provided to determine whether the respondent satisfies the requirements. Respondents that successfully qualify will be provided with the Tender Documentation and a password to access the Documents.

The Premier's Department may contact respondents to seek clarification or additional information where required.

### Mandatory requirements
1. #### Modern slavery *

**Building and property - Facility maintenance**

This procurement category has a heightened risk of modern slavery.

You will be asked to provide information about modern slavery risks in your business and any actions you have taken to address these. You can visit the NSW Anti-slavery Commissioner’s [GRS webpage](https://dcj.nsw.gov.au/legal-and-justice/our-commissioners/anti-slavery-commissioner/due-diligence-and-reporting.html) for more information.

Do you agree to provide this information?

**Response type**

Checkbox (Agree)
2. #### Social procurement (SME Policy) *

**Building and property - Facility maintenance**

Category and estimated value is subject to social procurement.

If you are successful in winning this opportuntity you will be required to submit quarterly reporting, do you agree?

**Response type**

Radio button (Yes/No)

### Opportunity requirements

**1.**

**Part A.0 Mandatory Qualifying Questions**

Please complete the attached documents:

- Part A.0 Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Upon receipt, the Premier's Department will review the information provided to determine whether the respondent satisfies the qualification requirements. Respondents that successfully qualify will be provided with the Tender Documentation and a password to access them.
